user.title: Add a local TP-Link device
user.description: Identify a supported TP-Link/Kasa/Tapo device directly on your LAN.

dl100.title: Add Tapo DL100
dl100.description: DL100 was discovered locally. One explicit provisioning step is required by the lock firmware to establish an encrypted DLKLAP session. The resulting LAN session is saved for local-first runtime control.

reconfigure.title: Reprovision DL100 local session
reconfigure.description: The saved DLKLAP session expired or was rejected. Enter the Tapo account credentials to explicitly provision a replacement session. Normal runtime never performs this step automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device locally or establish its required local session.
error.unsupported_device: This device does not expose a supported local-control protocol.
